synthesis.evidence_balance: mixed — a still-growing, unlevered franchise with loyal core demand against a real EBITDA roll-over, cash burn, lost premium-trial and an unfavorable forward multiple.

bull_points.claim: Revenue has compounded from $261M (2021) to $784M LTM Mar-29-2026 with latest same-quarter YoY of +15.4%, so this is a still-growing top line, not a structural revenue collapse.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement + Segments + Ratios (multi-year columns)

bull_points.claim: Absolute EBITDA rose from $4M (2021) to a peak of $103M (FY2025) and stands at $79M LTM, so the EBITDA-margin slip to 10% LTM is a margin-% effect with absolute EBITDA still far above its history — the % can fall while absolute EBITDA stays large.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

bull_points.claim: The balance sheet is essentially unlevered (net-debt/EBITDA 0.0x, net-debt/OCF 0.3x) with interest coverage of 99.4x and the nearest maturity wall in 2029, so this is not a leverage-driven distress story.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Net Debt $3M [Q1 Mar-29-2026] ÷ CIQ EBITDA $80M [LTM 12 months Mar-29-2026]

bull_points.claim: On the fundamental deltas the name screens with far better revenue growth (26% vs peer-median 4%), positive EBITDA growth (6% vs peer-median -11%) and far lower leverage (Debt/EBITDA 0.1 vs 3.8) than the peer median, posing whether the discount is RESIDUAL rather than fully EARNED — the human must judge against the heterogeneous peer set.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Operating Statistics (name vs peer median: growth/margin/leverage/beta)

bull_points.claim: Management frames 2026 explicitly as a 'low watermark for margins in this cycle' driven by temporary price-gap and oversupply dynamics, with cost actions (ECS staffing, feed, ~10% remote headcount cut, ~$75M CapEx reduction) expected to flow through in 2027 — a mean-revert posture rather than terminal demand loss.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript(s): Vital Farms, Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call, May 07, 2026.rtf; Vital Farms, Inc., Q4 2025 Earnings Call, Feb 26, 2026.rtf

bull_points.claim: Demand-side evidence cited by management is consistent with a pricing problem rather than brand erosion — existing consumers stayed loyal (buy-rate units per retained household +2% vs prior 8-quarter average) and a targeted price-gap narrowing at a top-10 customer lifted volume 18% in two weeks, plus distribution wins (TDP +15%–25% planned for 2026).
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript(s): Vital Farms, Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call, May 07, 2026.rtf; Vital Farms, Inc., Q4 2025 Earnings Call, Feb 26, 2026.rtf

bull_points.claim: The board authorized a $100M share repurchase program and the share count has been flat-to-down (-0.6% over ~1.7y), so there is no dilution offsetting the de-rate and management is signalling capital-return intent.
bull_points.source_ref: EDGAR 8-K item codes at the gap-down dates (not blanket-labelled earnings)

bull_points.claim: Sell-side context remains constructive with an Outperform (2.00) consensus rating and mean target $11.67 versus a name implied by a $480M cap, a genuine gap between consensus posture and price action.

bear_points.claim: LTM EBITDA margin has rolled over from a 14% FY2025 peak to 10% LTM and gross margin from 38% to 35%, and absolute LTM EBITDA has fallen from the $103M peak to $79M — here the margin-% decline is corroborated by a REAL drop in absolute EBITDA, so this is a genuine signal, not merely an optical %-compression.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

bear_points.claim: The company is burning cash with levered FCF of -$53.9M LTM, so despite the unlevered balance sheet it is consuming liquidity and runway depends on a cash balance not derived in the facts.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Cash Flow 'Levered Free Cash Flow' [LTM 12 months Mar-29-2026]

bear_points.claim: Management's own thesis-critical claim that the brand still supports a premium is being repriced — new-household trial dropped from >55% to 50% as price gaps reached levels 'our brand could not sustain,' meaning the premium may be structurally smaller than the multi-year margin path assumed.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript(s): Vital Farms, Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call, May 07, 2026.rtf; Vital Farms, Inc., Q4 2025 Earnings Call, Feb 26, 2026.rtf

bear_points.claim: The de-rate is sharply idiosyncratic, not market-driven: the name is down 69% over 180 days while IWM rose 18%, an -84% relative move concentrated on the company's own news.

The drawdown sits on discrete company-specific 8-K events — a Feb-2026 founder/Executive-Chairperson departure (5.02) and a May-2026 decision to wind down and discontinue the entire butter product line (2.05 exit/disposal) — i.e. management turnover plus a product-line exit, not a one-off macro miss.
bear_points.source_ref: EDGAR 8-K item codes at the gap-down dates (not blanket-labelled earnings)

bear_points.claim: The business is single-segment and single-geography (Eggs and Butter 100%, United States 100%) — and one of those two products is now being discontinued — leaving narrow, commodity-exposed concentration with no diversification cushion.

The forward multiple disconfirms the cheap-on-trailing read: NTM TEV/EBITDA is 70.81 vs peer median 8.98 and NTM P/E is NM (a real negative-base state), so on a forward basis the name is NOT cheap — the 1.5x trailing EV/EBITDA reflects a peak-EBITDA denominator about to compress.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Trading Multiples (name row + Summary Statistics Low/Median/Mean/High)

bear_points.claim: EBITDA margin is below the peer median (10% vs 15%), so part of the valuation discount is EARNED on profitability even before the 2026 margin reset lands.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Operating Statistics (name vs peer median: growth/margin/leverage/beta)

decisive_question.question: Is the 2026 margin and velocity collapse a temporary, fixable price-gap/oversupply reset (mean-revert from a still-growing, unlevered franchise) or evidence that the brand's sustainable price premium — and thus its peak-EBITDA earning power — is structurally lower than the multi-year path implied?

evidence_for.claim: Management characterizes 2026 as a 'low watermark for margins' from temporary price gaps and oversupply, with loyal existing consumers (buy-rate +2%) and a targeted price-gap fix lifting one customer's volume 18% in two weeks.
evidence_for.source_ref: CIQ transcript(s): Vital Farms, Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call, May 07, 2026.rtf; Vital Farms, Inc., Q4 2025 Earnings Call, Feb 26, 2026.rtf

evidence_for.claim: Revenue is still growing (+15.4% latest same-quarter YoY) and the balance sheet is unlevered (net-debt/EBITDA 0.0x, coverage 99.4x), giving time for the cost program to land in 2027.
evidence_for.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement + Segments + Ratios (multi-year columns)

evidence_against.claim: New-household trial fell from >55% to 50% because price gaps reached levels 'our brand could not sustain,' and the forward multiple (NTM TEV/EBITDA 70.81, NTM P/E NM) implies the market expects sharp forward EBITDA compression rather than a clean trailing-cheap setup.
evidence_against.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Trading Multiples (name row + Summary Statistics Low/Median/Mean/High)

evidence_against.claim: Absolute LTM EBITDA already fell from $103M to $79M and the company is FCF-negative (-$53.9M) while exiting an entire product line (butter) and losing its founder/Executive Chairperson — concrete deterioration, not just optics.
evidence_against.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Cash Flow 'Levered Free Cash Flow' [LTM 12 months Mar-29-2026]

key_unknowns: Cash, cash-equivalents and marketable-securities balance is not derived in the source facts, so runway = cash ÷ burn against the -$53.9M LTM FCF cannot be computed — a BEARISH opacity given the negative FCF (survival_capacity explicitly flags cash 'not derived — a risk').

Revised 2026 guidance is UNKNOWN — no revised-outlook 99.1 exhibit was parsed for either gap-down 8-K, so the magnitude of the management-flagged margin reset is undisclosed in the facts (a missing expected forward disclosure, treated as a bearish gap).

Adjusted EBITDA, adjusted EPS and adjusted net-debt/EBITDA are all UNKNOWN — management speaks to non-GAAP measures but the adjusted figures are not in the supplied facts, so the forward NTM TEV/EBITDA of 70.81 cannot be reconciled to management's adjusted basis.
Segment-level EBITDA is UNKNOWN (no EBITDA section on the Segments sheet), so the profitability impact of discontinuing the butter line versus the core egg business cannot be isolated.

Consensus revision breadth is 0↑/0↓ last month for both EPS and revenue, so it is not yet clear whether sell-side estimates and the $11.67 target have been cut to reflect the May reset — the Outperform rating may be stale.
No exposed cohort/cross-section (VITL absent from graph_coverage), so the idiosyncratic read rests only on the name-vs-IWM relative, with no peer-of-shock comparison.
